body.en: Wash reusable pads or cups with clean water and soap after each use.
body.sw: Osha pedi au vikombe vinavyotumika tena kwa maji safi na sabuni baada ya kila matumizi.

body.en: Dry reusable products fully before using them again, in a clean place with air and, where possible, sunlight.
body.sw: Kausha bidhaa zinazotumika tena kabisa kabla ya kuzitumia tena, mahali safi penye hewa na, inapowezekana, mwanga wa jua.

body.en: Store clean, dry products in a clean, dry bag or container away from dirt and moisture.
body.sw: Hifadhi bidhaa safi na kavu kwenye mfuko au chombo safi na kikavu mbali na uchafu na unyevu.

body.en: Reusable products are offered only where there is access to clean water, soap, privacy, a place to wash, a place to dry thoroughly, and safe storage. Where these are missing, disposable products are offered instead.
body.sw: Bidhaa zinazotumika tena zinatolewa tu pale panapo maji safi, sabuni, faragha, mahali pa kuosha, mahali pa kukausha kabisa, na uhifadhi salama. Pale hivi vinakosekana, bidhaa za kutupwa zinatolewa badala yake.

body.en: Use each disposable pad once, change it regularly, and never reuse it.
body.sw: Tumia kila pedi ya kutupwa mara moja, ibadilishe mara kwa mara, na usiitumie tena.

body.en: Wrap used disposable products and dispose of them with household waste or as locally advised; do not flush them.
body.sw: Funga bidhaa za kutupwa zilizotumika na uzitupe pamoja na taka za nyumbani au kama inavyoshauriwa kieneo; usizitupe chooni.

title.en: When not to use and when to seek care
title.sw: Wakati wa kutotumia na wakati wa kutafuta huduma

body.en: Do not use a product that is damaged, wet from storage, or past its condition. If a customer feels unwell, has pain, unusual bleeding or a rash, do not give health advice or try to name the cause: refer them to the nearest health facility.
body.sw: Usitumie bidhaa iliyoharibika, iliyolowa kwenye hifadhi, au iliyopitwa na hali. Mteja akijisikia vibaya, akiwa na maumivu, kuvuja damu kusiko kawaida au upele, usitoe uchunguzi: mpe rufaa kwenye kituo cha afya kilicho karibu.

sections.source: handbook v3.1 §8E, §12 (Customer feels unwell → Show Health Referral Guidance)
